cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says government data or a core system is hosted in a national data centre or cloud.
cells.note: The Data Protection Act, in effect since January 2025, requires a copy of personal data to stay in Botswana (BWA-001), so stage 3. The move of government systems to the Delta data centre is described as under way, not done (BWA-002), so not 4.
